title: Connection pool leak after hotfix
pattern: Errors spike within 2h of deploy; latency climbs above 800ms; checkout_flow dominates failures.

title: Upstream identity provider degradation
pattern: Elevated latency without deploy change; intermittent timeouts on token validation.
remediation: Scale auth-service replicas and enable circuit breaker on identity provider.

title: Request spike exhausting thread pool
pattern: Sudden traffic spike; gateway latency rises before downstream errors.
remediation: Enable rate limiting and scale api-gateway horizontally.
